desc: I wonder how often Koishi visits Myōrenji. Like, going by the pace that leads to the footnote in the [**Symposium**](https://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Symposium_of_Post-mysticism/Part_4#:~:text=後日、勧誘により入門したそうです。出家はせず、在家ですが。), it seems Byakuren only managed to get Koishi in, but failed to actually get her ordained?
